options: Through the laying on of Paul's hands

questions.answer: guard that which I have committed

Which three examples does Paul use to encourage Timothy?
options: A soldier, an athlete, and a farmer
A shepherd, a builder, and a fisherman
A king, a priest, and a prophet
A servant, a steward, and a judge

options: Christ did not come in the flesh
The day of the Lord has come

questions.q: To whom should Timothy commit the things he heard from Paul?
options: Faithful men able to teach others
All who gather in his house

items: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead

options: His cloak, the books, and the parchments
